marketing.hero.badge: Beta access — free for early teams
marketing.hero.sub: Connect your project tracker, describe what you did in plain English, and let the AI propose a per-task distribution you can accept in two clicks. Works with OpenProject, Jira, Linear, and GitLab — or our native PM if you have none.
marketing.hero.finePrint: No credit card · 14-day trial · cancel anytime
marketing.preview.heading: Every project, one source of truth.
marketing.preview.sub: Hours, members, rates, and tracker sync — on the same page, in the same place your team already looks.
marketing.howItWorks.heading: Three steps from tracker to timesheet.
marketing.howItWorks.step1Body: Plug in OpenProject, Jira, Linear, or GitLab in under a minute. No tracker? Use the built-in PM and skip the setup.
marketing.howItWorks.step2Body: Type what you did in plain English. TimeFlow's AI reads your tracker activity and proposes a per-task split that already adds up.
marketing.howItWorks.step2Placeholder: Worked on auth refactor and onboarding QA…
marketing.howItWorks.step3Body: Tweak any cell, approve the week, and watch the hours land in your tracker and on the next invoice — automatically.
marketing.featureGrid.heading: Built for teams that hate logging hours.
marketing.featureGrid.sub: The features the team built for themselves — after years of forgetting Friday afternoons.
marketing.featureGrid.card1Body: OpenProject, Jira, Linear, GitLab, and your native PM all land in the same monthly heatmap. No tab juggling.
marketing.featureGrid.card2Body: Every proposed split shows which commit, comment, or status change it came from. No black box, no guessing.
marketing.featureGrid.card3Body: Weekly sign-off flows through the same UI the team already logs hours in. Managers see only what they need.
marketing.featureGrid.card4Body: Per-project rates cascade where you want, snapshot at invoice time, and export as PDF or CSV in one click.
marketing.featureGrid.card5Body: Run several clients, agencies, or internal squads from one login. Permissions follow the project tree.
marketing.featureGrid.card6Body: Encrypted secrets, full export under Article 20, and account deletion that respects shared history.
marketing.testimonials.heading: Less ceremony. More billable hours.
marketing.testimonials.quote1: I was rebuilding my whole week from commit history every Friday. Now I describe what I did, accept the split, and I'm done before lunch.
marketing.testimonials.quote2: Sync to invoice used to take us a full afternoon per client. With TimeFlow it's three clicks — and the rates are already right.
marketing.testimonials.quote3: Our devs stopped resenting timesheets the week we switched. That alone paid for the plan.
marketing.faq.heading: Everything you'd ask before signing up.
marketing.faq.sub: Straight answers. If yours isn't here, hit reply on any of our emails.
marketing.faq.a1: While we're in beta, it's free for the first ten seats of any team. After we leave beta, plans start at €7 per active user per month, billed monthly, with no annual lock-in.
marketing.faq.q2: Who owns the data I log?
marketing.faq.a2: You do. Every worklog, project, and rate is exportable as CSV or JSON at any time. We sign a DPA on request and our servers run inside the EU.
marketing.faq.a3: OpenProject, Jira Cloud, Linear, and GitLab Issues today. If you don't use any of them, the built-in native PM gives you projects, tasks, and rates without leaving TimeFlow.
marketing.faq.q4: How do you keep our credentials safe?
marketing.faq.a4: Tracker tokens are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM using per-connection associated data, never logged, and only decrypted inside the request that needs them. Passwords use Argon2id; 2FA is available out of the box.
marketing.faq.q5: Can we migrate from our current tool?
marketing.faq.a5: Yes. Import past worklogs as CSV during signup, or let us pull the last quarter from your existing tracker. Your team picks up exactly where they left off.
